name: Empire building
source:
EB is a social building, with a communal way of life in which relationships between residents prevail.

After spending some time in the hospital due to an accident in a GT-R race, you decide to retire from racing and totally change your lifestyle, with the help of your older brother's widow you found an old closed hotel and converted it in what is currently.

[From [URL=https://docrivers0.itch.io/empire-building]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
EB是一栋社会建筑，拥有居民之间建立关系的公共生活方式。

由于在GT-R比赛中发生事故而住院一段时间后，你决定退出赛车并彻底改变你的生活方式，在你哥哥的遗孀的帮助下，你找到了一家关闭的旧酒店并将其改造成现在的样子。

[来自 [URL=https://docrivers0.itch.io/empire-building]Itch.io[/URL]]
